title: Syllable
description: PROP-8: one sung syllable, stored in Phrase.syllables. It STARTS at anchor (a trajectory of the same phrase's main string, trajectoryGrid[0]); its extent is implied: it runs to the next syllable's anchor or to a silence trajectory (id 12), whichever comes first, even across a phrase boundary within the track. Time lives only in Trajectory.durTot. onset/nucleus/coda/tone are KEYS into the piece's phoneme pack (system.phonology, absent = hindi-urdu); IPA and display forms are derived from the pack, never stored here. Invariants (checked on load, see PROPOSALS.md PROP-8): every anchor names a trajectory of this phrase's trajectoryGrid[0] that is not a silence; anchors are in trajectory order, at most one per trajectory; in a track that has syllables, the first non-silent trajectory of the track and every non-silent trajectory after a silence start a syllable; anchor.t is 0 in 0.3.x.

traj.description: uniqueId of the trajectory the syllable starts on.

t.description: Position inside that trajectory, 0-1. Defaults to 0; must be 0 in 0.3.x (no system allows otherwise yet). Reserved so a mid-trajectory onset is a data change, not a contract break.

orthography.description: Written form as the text gives it (詩, बा, her). Free text: no validation or lookup in 0.3.0.

romanization.description: Romanized form: Jyutping with tone digit (si1), ISO 15919 for Hindi (bā), Kurmanji as spelled.

onset.description: Pack consonant key, or an array of keys for a cluster where the pack allows (flags.onsetClusters).

nucleus.description: Pack vowel key. Absent only where the pack allows: a syllabic final (Jyutping m, ng) or flags.nucleusOptional.

coda.description: Pack coda key, or an array where the pack allows (flags.codaClusters). Sits at the end of the syllable's last trajectory; no anchor of its own.

tone.description: Key of the pack's tone set (Jyutping '1'-'6'). A label only in 0.3.0.

wordStart.description: true when this syllable begins a word (ba of ba·bul).

lyric.description: The vowel the text says: typed by a person ('human') or derived by the pack or the legacy heal ('pack'). vowel is a pack vowel key, or null when the syllable has none (a healed group with no vowel, a syllabic nasal).

sung.description: The vowel measured in the audio: filled by a model ('model'), a person may override ('human'). Synthesis reads sung when present, else lyric. Not projected to the legacy fields.
